answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 67699 Country: INDIA Title: Details about sunnah hair Question: Give me the sunnah of head hair. How many ways I can keep my hairs provide me details. Answer ID: 67699 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1163/1133/H=11/1437) It is lawful and sunnah to grow the hair of head up to the lobe of ears or below it or up to the shoulders. (Fatwa Mahmoodia aur Us ka Hashia, vol. 1, p. 433), pub. Darul Maarif, Deoband). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
